name: Dendrochronology
promptTemplate: A cross-section of a {{species}} trunk growing year by year at {{growth_speed}}x speed with {{knots_count}} branch knots and {{climate_volatility}} climate volatility, revealing {{cracks_detail}} and {{bark_texture}}.

ui.title: Dendrochronology
ui.tagline: Botanical ring simulator and climate record

species.hint: Sets wood hue, heartwood tones, and latewood density

growth_speed.hint: Accelerates or slows annual radial expansion

knots_count.hint: Number of branch dipoles distorting grain path

cracks_detail.hint: Pattern of radial heartshakes and frost fissures

bark_texture.hint: Outer perimeter ruggedness and rim coloration

gallery.blurb: Tree rings: a cross-section of a trunk growing year by year, each ring's width set by an invented climate, with knots, cracks and bark, growing slowly.
gallery.prompt: Tree rings: a cross-section of a trunk growing year by year, each ring's width set by an invented climate, with knots, cracks and bark, growing slowly. Build it with a demoscener's economy: one core technique done well, lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
